manaNeeded: {2}{U} plus enough mana to cast the instant or sorcery from your hand
notablePrerequisites: You have an instant or sorcery card in hand.
description:
Cast any instant or sorcery spell.
Holding priority, cast Cooperate from your graveyard by paying {2}{U}.
Sevinne triggers, creating a copy of Cooperate, targeting Cooperate.
Resolve the copy of Cooperate, creating a copy of Cooperate, targeting Cooperate.
Repeat step 4.
